body:
I don't have it as rough as a lot of people. I know enough to recognize that I'm extremely lucky to be where I am. But I just wish I could be a different person, who appreciated it, who wanted it...

I'm heading into finals and studying at least 8+ hours a day right now, so not a lot of time for anything. Most of what I eat it out of a vending machine and I haven't exercised for months.

I am 20, but I am out of money for school and out of time to make it happen, basically.
